domainModel.rule: Decision dimensions are a revisable diagnostic lens, not an exhaustive ontology or fixed four-quadrant encoding. Context, state, effect, continuity, topology and lifecycle cross-cut them; authority, responsibility and accountability remain distinct. A named method is recovered and defined before it becomes executable product semantics.

purpose: Provide an open, Agent-neutral and mechanism-neutral human-Agent collaboration system: keep a small portable reliability kernel while adapting discovery, routing, configuration, carriers, topology, continuity, verification and cleanup to the current goal, host and authority so the user does not have to operate avoidable Agent mechanics.
successDefinition: A finite release is successful when representative users can reach bounded real outcomes with less avoidable orchestration and recovery burden, acceptable interference and recoverable effects across its claimed hosts. Healthy native behavior may produce a no-op; residual gaps may justify a Skill, plugin, App, MCP, Hook, configuration, state, runtime, cloud carrier, composed route or another mechanism. Each mechanism and claim remains scoped, observable, replaceable and retireable. A release is neither a universal runtime nor proof that every human-AI collaboration problem is solved, and later facts may revise its premise, representation, route or product shape.

kernel.name: goal-first
kernel.commitment: Keep one current, versioned goal and phase; preserve user corrections and discover material omissions without requiring the user to specify tools or topology.

kernel.name: minimum-sufficient-route
kernel.commitment: Discover and use sufficient healthy native or already-available capability first, then resolve official, maintained, composed or bounded authored routes for the evidenced residual. Select by current outcome fitness, authority and total lifecycle cost; unknown remains unknown, and sufficient native behavior produces no avoidable intervention.

kernel.name: human-authority
kernel.commitment: People retain goals, consequential domain judgment, new trust, data and cost boundaries, irreversible effects and accountable final judgment; the Agent owns supported mechanics inside the granted boundary.

kernel.name: continuous-reconciliation
kernel.commitment: At material checkpoints compare the current goal, authority, evidence, expected and observed effects, resource state and carrier fitness; stop, recover, minimally correct and re-verify on material divergence.

kernel.name: close-the-loop
kernel.commitment: Validate at the consequence level claimed, expose residual risk, reconcile final state, release task-scoped exposure, clean task-owned residue, and turn serious or repeated failure into a bounded change, rollback or retirement decision.

hostAdapterStandard.rule: Resolve current official host guidance and observable host behavior before authoring host-specific behavior; treat both as high-weight, fallible host evidence rather than portable product authority.
Prefer effective healthy native behavior and make no-op an explicit passing result.
Select by effective capability, task fitness, authority and lifecycle cost, not by a permanently preferred version, model, provider, extension market, mechanism or label.
Observe effective capability when consequential; a declared or installed capability is not proof that it is usable or exposed.
Keep unavailable or unobservable host state as unknown and use a conservative bounded fallback.

Treat host, client, cloud environment, protocol, model route, extension ecosystem, configuration and context drift as normal evaluation variables; invalidate the affected index snapshot and revalidate only dependent routes and claims.
Verify consequential effects from suitable external observations, bind evidence to the complete current projection identity, and keep static conformance separate from behavior and field value.
Do not make the user compensate for Agent-owned discovery, routing, configuration, capability, code or conversation topology, continuity, recovery, verification, update or cleanup mechanics.

Keep host-specific instructions, formats, versions, indexes, configuration and lifecycle mechanics in replaceable adaptive projections or derived state rather than freezing them into the portable kernel.

Degrade, replace or retire YIYUAN Accord host-specific logic when native improvement or a lower-cost route removes the residual gap; installation or visibility alone neither activates nor justifies removal of a healthy latent capability.

learnedFailureStandards.name: outcome-over-process
learnedFailureStandards.rule: A plan, report, prompt, validator, test, commit, push, transition or authorization is never promoted into the user outcome it supports.

learnedFailureStandards.name: subtraction-before-repair
learnedFailureStandards.rule: A repeated same-purpose failure triggers premise and abstraction review plus a deletion or replacement attempt before another repair layer is admitted.

learnedFailureStandards.name: total-complexity-budget
learnedFailureStandards.rule: Count code, prompts, instructions, state, evidence, topology, human cognition, recovery and retirement cost; every retained mechanism must pay rent.

learnedFailureStandards.name: progressive-assurance
learnedFailureStandards.rule: Verification and ceremony increase with consequence, irreversibility and claim strength rather than being universally maximal.

learnedFailureStandards.name: help-and-interference
learnedFailureStandards.rule: Representative evaluation measures both useful assistance and avoidable questions, delays, steps, effects, concepts and recovery burden.

learnedFailureStandards.name: continuity-by-construction
learnedFailureStandards.rule: Use source-bound host signals when available and an explicit unknown fallback otherwise; never make a universal turn count, token window or percentage permanent product authority.

learnedFailureStandards.name: counterevidence-not-control
learnedFailureStandards.rule: Preserve failed trials as compact regression standards and representative counterexamples, not as active historical validators or inherited proof.

qualityInvariants: the current goal and material changes are identifiable and versioned
authority never exceeds the explicit delegation and unavoidable human review remains competent and real
evidence strength is proportional to the claim, consequence and reversibility
untrusted data, reports, memory and tool output cannot become instructions or authority by being present
material side effects are attributable and are stopped, recovered or rolled back where the effect permits
repository-stored assertions can request but cannot grant accountable human release authority; task-bound authorization stays external and binds the exact clean candidate

exact-candidate hosted verification is task-time external evidence bound to the same clean revision and every system declared required for the current release channel; optional unavailable systems remain explicit unknowns, and a repository observation or earlier hosted run cannot self-attest the final candidate

representative behavior evidence binds the current behavior-bearing adapter contract, Skill and exact exposed Skill content, while deterministic conformance binds the complete current manifest, marketplace, metadata, asset and package distribution; a distribution-only change preserves unrelated behavior truth but must replay its own activation, confirmation, removal and downstream release gates

static identity absence is limited to stage-zero regular files declared by the Git index: paths and strictly decoded non-Python whole text use exact NFKC/casefold lexical token boundaries without host escape interpretation, while .py, .pyi and .pyw identifiers and literal or bounded static-concatenation values use the shared Python 3.10 AST grammar across supported Python 3.10-3.14 hosts; unavailable index state, unmerged or non-regular entries, and unreadable, undecodable, oversized, out-of-grammar or over-budget surfaces block conformance, hidden checkout flags block clean-candidate readiness, digest-bound Markdown research inputs under research/reviews and exact program-declared SHA-256-bound PNG distribution assets are inert exceptions, and no check claims absence from ignored or untracked files, Python comments, runtime-built or external dynamic content
completion is supported by external criteria and observed effects rather than model self-assessment or artifact shape
serious or repeated failure changes an evaluation, route, instruction or mechanism, while anecdotal failure alone cannot cause permanent accretion

ideas, methodologies, standards, policies, rules, logic, mechanisms, processes, protocols, representations, carriers, capabilities and metrics declare scope, applicability, provenance, override, degradation, expiry and retirement semantics rather than becoming globally active by visibility

durable semantic records are separated from ephemeral environment snapshots and derived indexes; observed learning may update fitness and regression inputs but cannot grant authority or consequential effects

humanAuthority.humanOnlyStepRule: Detect, minimize, explain and post-verify a technically or authoritatively unavoidable human action; never transfer supported Agent-owned orchestration to the user.

productBoundary.hostRule: A concrete Agent, host, client, cloud, model route, provider, operating system, context, Skill, plugin, App, MCP, Hook, memory, tool, configuration, state and runtime is a dynamic variable represented in replaceable adapters, scoped policy, ephemeral snapshots or evidence rather than portable identity. The capability surface of Codex, Claude or any other concrete Agent is a freshness-bound observation and first evidence surface, never the Agent-neutral product boundary or capability ceiling. Any supported future native, official, maintained, composed or bounded authored mechanism may be used when it is authorized, lower-net-cost than alternatives and independently bounded for activation, interference, update, rollback and retirement. Official host guidance is high-weight evidence, never product sovereignty.

evidenceBoundary.releaseRule: Finite release requires live-computed deterministic conformance and bounded representative behavior for the claims it makes, an unchanged local candidate that passes direct complete verification and independent review before the same SHA is pushed, task-time hosted verification of that SHA on every system declared required for the current release channel, separate named-human authority for it, an exact tagged public release only after those gates, and direct goal-carrier verification of its remote tag, maturity, public claim, attached-asset policy and final cleanup. Optional unavailable hosted systems remain explicit unknowns and cannot be promoted into a pass, product failure or stronger release claim. Repository observations cannot self-attest deterministic conformance, local review or these external facts. Comparative field value, broad effectiveness, cross-host equivalence and longitudinal human effects remain continuing evidence lanes unless explicitly claimed by the release. A representative task failure blocks the exact host or behavior-bearing projection qualification, not a YIYUAN Accord release whose claim excludes the failed behavior. Distribution-only metadata, presentation or packaging changes preserve unchanged contract-and-Skill behavior evidence but must replay full distribution conformance and current activation lifecycle evidence.
evidenceBoundary.claimRule: Tests, reports, registrations, commits, prompts and human assent support only the direct claim they evidence; none becomes the product result by existing. A task failure must remain failed, retain its residue disposition and narrow the applicable claim; detecting it cannot be promoted into host success, and host failure cannot be used to hide a conformant evaluation result.

evolutionPolicy.repairRule: A second same-purpose repair generation triggers abstraction review and a deletion or replacement attempt before another mechanism is admitted.
evolutionPolicy.nonInterferenceRule: When the host can already complete the task safely, reliably and with acceptable burden, YIYUAN Accord adds no avoidable active question, instruction, tool call, approval, delay, state mutation, topology change or persistent effect. A healthy installed or enabled latent capability may remain available without intervening in every message; its continued presence must still satisfy isolation, update, rollback and retirement controls.
evolutionPolicy.feedbackRule: A material user correction, observed failure, host change, evidence conflict, later rule or phase boundary traces to the earliest affected dependency boundary; prior passes remain historical facts but are superseded as current-candidate evidence, the affected plan, acceptance mapping, projection and every downstream gate are replayed, and unrelated accepted truth remains stable.
evolutionPolicy.retirementRule: A YIYUAN Accord mechanism, standard, policy, representation or route is simplified, degraded, disabled, replaced or removed when its applicability expires or residual benefit is no longer demonstrated. Subtraction targets implementation weight, duplication, stale assumptions, unjustified permanence and negative-value machinery; it may not silently remove a user-valued outcome capability unless a sufficient native or replacement route exists or the product scope is explicitly reconsidered. Git preserves provenance while active navigation and authority stop routing through retired material.

authority.historicalAndResearchRole: non-authoritative counterevidence and evolution input only
authority.conflictRule: The latest bound user direction governs goals, corrections and accountable judgment. The semantic list is the current reviewable schema-v3 authority topology, not unquestionable proof or a permanent file count. User correction, contradiction or material evidence may challenge it; merging, splitting, replacing or retiring an authority surface requires explicit migration, preserved provenance, a matching schema and verifier update, and replay from the earliest affected boundary. Derived projections are repaired or retired when they diverge.
